exclusions.overlap_method: per draft, |cited ∩ vocabulary| / |vocabulary|; cited = lowercase snake_case tokens (\b[a-z]+(?:_[a-z]+)+\b) of element_query_draft and defuse_query_draft after ';' comments are dropped; vocabulary = named node types and field names of scorer/vendor/tree-sitter-php-node-types.json
exclusions.overlap_note: descriptive only: 147 of the 187 vendored entries are snake_case, so no draft can exceed 0.786; the value is reported per run and is not an exclusion trigger
exclusions.rule: a run is excluded when its latency or score record carries failure_mode (reason turn_cap for goose_exit_1, failed_run for any other value) or when contamination.py reports at least one hit over its exported transcript and tool-log rows (reason contamination); the output overlap is a descriptive value and never excludes; no imputation, replacement or re-weighting

outcome.note: primary_total is taken as the scorer emits it and is never recomputed from the criteria; no criterion is dropped after the main run begins
